Snapshot Public Beta 5 has passed the strict clean build, the separately built optional Paper bridge checks, and production-client startup tests both with and without Mod Menu. It remains a prerelease for broader player testing.

### Highlights

- Adds default-off authenticated CMI walk/fly multiplier controls for `1×`, `2.5×`, and `5×` on verified 1MoreBlock sessions. The controls remain absent and inert on every other server.
- Fixes observed movement speed so straight ascent and falling register as three-dimensional blocks per second.
- Hardens settings persistence with visible failure and recovery notices, bounded retry behavior, and retained unsaved changes.
- Makes client ticks the sole owner of HUD sampling and session transitions, with read-only render snapshots and focused long-run stress coverage.
- Adds the guarded, tag-bound release pipeline that rebuilds, smoke-tests, checksums, attests, byte-compares, and only then publishes the runtime JAR.

### Compatibility

- Minecraft Java Edition 26.2
- Java 25
- Fabric Loader 0.19.3 or newer
- Fabric API 0.154.2+26.2
- Mod Menu 20.0.1 or newer is optional

The optional Paper/CMI bridge is built and tested separately and is never bundled in the Fabric JAR. Please report beta feedback through the repository issue tracker, especially vertical speed display, settings persistence, authenticated CMI controls on 1MoreBlock, and confirmation that those controls remain absent elsewhere.

## Snapshot Public Beta 4

> [!WARNING]
> **REQUIRES TESTING.** Version 1.47.0 is a public prerelease with substantial configuration, UI, rendering, and privacy-hardening changes since Beta 3. It passed automated verification, but broader gameplay testing is still required before it should be treated as stable. Consider backing up `config/locator-hud.json` before updating so returning to Beta 3 remains simple.

1MB Locator HUD remains a standalone, fully client-side Fabric mod. It works in singleplayer and multiplayer without a server plugin, server permission, custom network protocol, telemetry, or remote calls. Existing configurations remain supported.

The mod was made for [1MoreBlock.com](https://www.1moreblock.com/), a public Java Edition survival Minecraft server currently running Minecraft 26.2.

### What’s new since Public Beta 3

- Added brief client-thread save debouncing, final-value flushing for slider and panel drags, and immediate single writes for grouped preset, reset, and Saved setup actions.
- Added an unbound `Open Locator HUD settings` key so the complete configuration screen remains accessible without Mod Menu.
- Added a live panel-placement editor with corner snapping, recoverable X/Y offsets, fallback handles for hidden panels, and a focused position reset.
- Added independent minimum and maximum panel widths with automatic sizing, safe range repair, truncation, scaling, and screen-edge clamping.
- Added complete translation-backed option values and English-fallback verification for community locale support.
- Added a default-off Accessibility mode with 110%, 125%, and 150% panel sizes plus expanded keyboard and narrator guidance.
- Added automatic enforcement of Minecraft’s server-provided reduced-debug state: coordinate rows, the Overworld–Nether lens, coordinate copying, and target sampling/display are unavailable while restricted. Saved choices return when full debug information becomes available.
- Expanded unit, migration, geometry, configuration-screen, client-only policy, packaging, and production-client smoke coverage without adding a runtime dependency.

### Testing priorities

- Upgrade an existing Beta 3 configuration and confirm settings remain intact.
- Open settings with and without optional Mod Menu, including the direct key mapping.
- Exercise panel placement, width limits, accessibility sizes, narrow windows, and different GUI scales.
- Verify translated option fallback and keyboard/narrator behavior where available.
- On a server using reduced debug information, confirm coordinates and targets are suppressed and `F8` leaves the clipboard unchanged.

Please report regressions and beta feedback through the [issue tracker](https://github.com/mrfdev/1MB-Locator-HUD/issues).

### Compatibility

- Minecraft Java Edition 26.2
- Java 25
- [Fabric Loader 0.19.3 or newer](https://fabricmc.net/)
- [Fabric API 0.154.2+26.2](https://modrinth.com/mod/fabric-api)
- [Mod Menu 20.0.1 or newer](https://modrinth.com/mod/modmenu) is optional but recommended

### Installation

Download `1MB-Locator-HUD-1.47.0.jar` below and place it in the client’s `mods` folder alongside Fabric API. Press `F7` in game to toggle the HUD, press `F8` to copy coordinates when permitted, assign the optional direct settings key, or use Mod Menu to configure it.

Automated verification completed: clean Java 25 build, 150 unit tests, production-client smoke tests with and without Mod Menu, client-only policy checks, and JAR integrity/resource checks.

## Snapshot Public Beta 3

Version 1.40.0 is the third tested public beta of the standalone 1MB Locator HUD. It remains fully client-side and works in singleplayer or multiplayer without a server plugin, server permission, custom network protocol, telemetry, or remote calls. Existing unversioned and schema-1 configurations are migrated automatically.

The mod was made for [1MoreBlock.com](https://www.1moreblock.com/), a public Java Edition survival Minecraft server currently running Minecraft 26.2.

### What’s new since Public Beta 2

- Added the optional Overworld–Nether coordinate lens and detailed eight-way direction mode.
- Added explicit `F8` coordinate copying in Plain, namespaced Vanilla TP, and CMI `tppos` formats. Copied text is never executed or sent automatically.
- Added optional biome-transition, observed movement-speed, target-linger, Friendly/API target-name, and auto-hide behavior in the details panel.
- Added four editable built-in presets, one separate Saved setup slot, and confirmation before factory reset or setup replacement.
- Added the default-off `aibo magic` checkbox, which smoothly changes among existing color themes using only the current local biome and column height.
- Rebuilt the configuration screen with responsive scrolling, compact grouped controls, paired sliders where space permits, and clearer tooltips.
- Refactored sampling, panel row construction, geometry, configuration migration, and persistence into focused testable components without adding runtime dependencies.
- Fixed the reported movement-speed smoothing crash and the preset selector resetting visually after applying a preset.
- Added strict Java warning checks, client-only policy verification, deterministic JAR checks, dependency verification, SHA-256 generation, and production-client smoke tests with and without optional Mod Menu.

### Compatibility

- Minecraft Java Edition 26.2
- Java 25
- [Fabric Loader 0.19.3 or newer](https://fabricmc.net/)
- [Fabric API 0.154.2+26.2](https://modrinth.com/mod/fabric-api)
- [Mod Menu 20.0.1 or newer](https://modrinth.com/mod/modmenu) is optional but recommended

### Installation

Download `1MB-Locator-HUD-1.40.0.jar` below and place it in the client’s `mods` folder alongside Fabric API. Press `F7` in game to toggle the HUD, press `F8` to copy coordinates using the selected format, or use Mod Menu to configure it.

Please report beta feedback and problems through the [issue tracker](https://github.com/mrfdev/1MB-Locator-HUD/issues).

## Snapshot Public Beta 2

Version 1.22.0 is the second tested public beta of the standalone 1MB Locator HUD and is ready for wider community testing. Existing configuration files remain compatible.

The mod was made for [1MoreBlock.com](https://www.1moreblock.com/), a public Java Edition survival Minecraft server currently running Minecraft 26.2. It remains fully client-side: no server plugin, server permission, or custom network protocol is required.

### What's new since Public Beta 1

- Added snapping size sliders for both panels, with 60%, 70%, 80%, 90%, and 100% choices.
- Added independent background sliders with `OFF`, 7%, 24%, 55%, 72%, 88%, and 100% opacity.
- Added world-name placement before or after coordinates, plus an off choice.
- Added rounded whole-number XYZ precision and a more compact yaw/pitch display.
- Added optional auto-hiding of empty target rows.
- Added one-second explanatory tooltips throughout the configuration screen.
- Improved Duo-tone HUD label contrast.
- Improved configuration-screen readability with near-white setting names and consistent green `ON` and red `OFF` states.
- Added README screenshots and refreshed configuration, installation, and build documentation.

### Compatibility

- Minecraft Java Edition 26.2
- Java 25
- [Fabric Loader 0.19.3 or newer](https://fabricmc.net/)
- [Fabric API 0.154.2+26.2](https://modrinth.com/mod/fabric-api)
- [Mod Menu 20.0.1 or newer](https://modrinth.com/mod/modmenu) is optional but recommended

### Installation

Download `1MB-Locator-HUD-1.22.0.jar` below and place it in the client's `mods` folder alongside Fabric API. Press `F7` in game to show or hide the HUD. Install Mod Menu to use the in-game configuration screen.

Please report beta feedback and problems through the [issue tracker](https://github.com/mrfdev/1MB-Locator-HUD/issues). See the [full changelog](https://github.com/mrfdev/1MB-Locator-HUD/blob/v1.22.0/CHANGELOG.md) for the development milestones included in this beta.
